title: Whole-genome CRISPR screening identifies N-glycosylation as a genetic and therapeutic vulnerability in CALR-mutant MPNs
model: BA/F3-MPL cells (empty vector or CALR del52), focused knockout library CP1547 (~245 genes x 8 guides)
contrast: CALR del52 without IL3 vs empty vector with IL3, day 21 (4 vs 4 independent lines)
paper_calls: 64 genes more depleted in CALR del52 and 8 more depleted in EV (corrected p < 0.05)
barcs_calls: 81 genes at FDR 0.10 (54 depleted, 27 enriched); 84 against the control null
named_hits: 8/8 recovered (Dpm3 #1, Dpm2 #3, Dpm1 #7, MPL #8, CALR #9, Mpdu1 #10, Stat5b #17, Jak2 #28)
verdict: Close agreement (Spearman 0.89, 62 of the top 64 shared, all named hits and all 8 EV-side genes called); the paper-only genes are pan-essential genes with jackpot-like guide counts across lines that BARCS does not call.
